title: Kiwi Panther
style: Phonk with a sneaky low-slung bounce and chopped halftime drums, built around beatbox percussion, sub growls, and clipped brass stabs rooted in New Zealand street-culture humor. Verse stays lean with backing singers as percussion and harmony pads; pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal clicks; chorus snaps with stacked hooks, Spanish licks, and crowd-style replies. Reverse swells, rim echoes, and quick tape cuts. Gritty, wide, punchy mix., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Eh-eh, kia ora
Mira, watch this
Prr-pah, prr-pah
Ha-ha, e hoa

[Verse 1]
Pulled up in gumboots
Fresh on the wet road
Steal a look, then vanish
Like a black cat in the shed

My cousins say, "Bro, go"
I say, "Sí, vamos"
Side-eye at the freezer
Got the last meat pie, then I ghost

Beatbox in the backseat
Tongue kick, cheek click
My mate says, "Too much?"
I say, "Ay, just a little bit"

Fish and chips in the glovebox
Salt on my hoodie
I grin, then I slide off
Like I never took the loot

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold tight
Hear that grin?
Too slick
Too mean
Prr-pah, hey
Mira, ahí
They laugh
Then they lean

[Chorus]
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Soft steps, hard bite
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Gone when you look twice
Oye, chico
Haere mai
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Run that night

[Verse 2]
At the dairy, I'm polite
Then I bend the line
"Any hot pies left?"
"Bro, one is mine"

Aunty on the porch
Says, "Boy, you moving weird"
I bow, "Gracias, aunty"
Then I fade through the rain

Backing voices clap time
Tick-tock, haka stomp
One singer does the bass
One singer does the spark

Weaving through the market
With a grin and a wink
Call me trouble, sweetheart
I just call it local sync

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold tight
Hear that grin?
Too slick
Too mean
Prr-pah, hey
Mira, ahí
They laugh
Then they lean

[Chorus]
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Soft steps, hard bite
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Gone when you look twice
Oye, chico
Haere mai
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Run that night

[Bridge]
Harmonics rise up
Like fog on the hill
Beatbox drops hollow
And the whole room stills

One more "sí"
One more cheer
Then I slip the back gate
Disappear

[Final Chorus]
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Soft steps, hard bite
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Gone when you look twice
Oye, chico
Haere mai
Kiwi panther, kiwi panther
Run that night

[Outro]
Eh-eh, kia ora
Mira, watch this
Prr-pah, prr-pah
Ha-ha, e hoa
